_doc: Fixtures whose spend requires a REAL cryptographic witness (ECDSA/Schnorr checkSig, secp256k1/NIST-P EC, SHA-256/BLAKE3/RIPEMD/Merkle hash-preimage, Rabin, or a post-quantum SLH-DSA/WOTS+ signature). The in-process differential oracle synthesises witnesses from plain args and cannot forge a valid signature or hash preimage, so these are covered instead by the Go conformance/script_execution_test.go real-crypto path (real ECDSA + tx context) and by the per-family codegen goldens (EC / SHA-256 / P256 / P384 / SLH-DSA / WOTS+). Each entry names the primitive that makes it crypto-bearing. See conformance/witnesses/README.md.
